The 1023-EZ approval URLs are not consistently named

Source: R/md-sources.R
md_f1023ez_urls.Rd

md_source_urls() renders one pattern, which is wrong for this source often enough to matter. The IRS has published these files under at least three conventions:

Details


  f1023ez_approvals_2014.xlsx     underscores, lowercase   2014-2016, 2018-2019
  f1023EZ_approvals_2017.xlsx     underscores, EZ upper    2017
  f1023ez-approvals-2020.xlsx     hyphens                  2020-2023

2024 is listed on the approvals page under /system/files/irs-tege/ and 404s, so the published range is 2014-2023 whatever the page implies.

The downloader therefore tries each convention rather than trusting one. This is recorded because a single-pattern fetch would silently acquire nine years and look complete.

Column names shift too: the EIN header is EIN through 2018 and Ein by 2023, which is why md_xlsx_to_csv() matches case-insensitively.
